title: Schalke-Stuttgart: Schalke, 17th, with three confirmed absences
text:
Schalke-Stuttgart: Schalke, 17th, with three confirmed absences Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board News 🇩🇪 Bundesliga 1d ago · November 20, 2026 Schalke-Stuttgart: Schalke, 17th, with three confirmed absences
 Schalke host Stuttgart on Saturday, 21 November, in Bundesliga matchday 10; the home side arrives with four defeats in its last five games.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 20, 2026 at 11:40 AM 
 Result FC Schalke 04 0 – 0 VfB Stuttgart Saturday 21 November Goals, ratings and stats → Schalke 04 host VfB Stuttgart on Saturday, 21 November, in matchday 10 of the Bundesliga, at the VELTINS-Arena. The referee will be Daniel Siebert.
 Schalke sit 17th with 6 points from 9 matches, and their last five results are one draw and four defeats. Stuttgart are 8th with 12 points from 9 matches, arriving with three wins and two defeats in their last five.

 T. Becker (foot injury), R. Schallenberg (leg injury) and M. Wober (muscle injury) are ruled out for Schalke; R. Gosens (knee) and L. Vozar (thigh) are doubtful. Stuttgart are missing J. Diehl (muscle), L. Jaquez (ribs), A. Stiller (groin) and D. Zagadou (muscle), all ruled out.
 In the last five meetings there were three draws, one Schalke win (2-1 in 2023) and one Stuttgart win (5-1 in 2021, with Stuttgart at home). Our data gives 10% to the home side, 45% to a draw and 45% to the away side, with fewer than 3.5 goals.
